evals.prompt: PR #8812 just got created. Can you send the team a notification about it?
evals.expected_output: Agent generates a formatted message following the skill's message format, then runs Send-PRTeamsNotification.ps1 with the correct PullRequestId, Message, and Destination. Reports success with the PR URL.
assertions: Agent generates a message matching the emoji + title + author + type + work items format
Agent uses a Destination value from the config (does not hardcode a destination)
Agent confirms the notification was sent and includes the PR link

evals.prompt: tell the team about the new PR
evals.expected_output: Even without an explicit PR number, agent asks for the PR ID (or reads it from context) and proceeds to send a Teams notification — skill is triggered by 'tell the team' intent.
assertions: Agent invokes the teams-notifications skill (does not just answer with text)
Agent asks for PR ID if not provided, or reads it from recent context
Agent does not skip the notification

evals.prompt: Send an email to the engineering team about PR #8812.
evals.expected_output: Agent should NOT use this skill — the destination is email, not Teams. Agent handles this with a different approach or explains it cannot send email.
assertions: Agent does not reference Teams configuration

evals.prompt: The deployment to staging succeeded. Can you post a message in Teams?
evals.expected_output: Agent uses this skill for a non-PR Teams notification (deployment event). Generates an appropriate message and runs the script.
assertions: Agent invokes teams-notifications skill for this non-PR event
Message reflects deployment context, not a generic PR template
Agent calls the script with a suitable Destination
